verdict.rationale: Glama is a hosted MCP gateway, registry and chat platform that logs calls and stores conversations and documents, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis for it. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion controls or data-lifecycle options. The adjacent items (private-by-default listings, saving and tagging conversations, gateway call logging) cover visibility and storage, not user control over retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
